verdict.rationale: Ashby's native AI Notetaker add-on is documented to record, transcribe, and summarize interviews, and to support higher-quality feedback. It rolls out across interviews and is governed by existing user permissions. However, the evidence never explicitly says summaries flow into the scorecard, and it does not address candidate consent at all. missing for 10: explicit scorecard auto-population from notes, candidate consent/recording-notice handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
